title: Balanced Freekeh and Goat Cheese Salad
subtitle: with Orange, Avocado and Rocket
description: Our 'balanced' recipes are just that – high in nutritive value (that's fibre-rich veggies, lean proteins and wholegrains, just between us), so these dishes are good for you in every which way! They're perfect for anyone looking to minimise their intake of refined foods without sacrificing on taste.

steps.text: Cook freekeh: Make sure your avocado is ripe before starting this recipe (see Kitchen hack). Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Cook the freekeh, partially covered, for 18-20 mins until tender. Drain and rinse under cold water.
Prep orange: Meanwhile, juice half the orange, then peel and thinly slice the remaining half.
Toast pepitas: Cook the pepitas in a cold small frypan over medium heat, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan.

Make orange vinaigrette: Drain 1½ tbs oil from the marinated goat cheese into a large bowl. Add the orange juice, 1 tbs white wine vinegar, 1 tsp dijon mustard and 2 tsp honey. Season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine.

Serve up: Thinly slice the avocado. Coarsely chop the goat cheese. Add the freekeh, rocket, sliced orange and half the pepitas to the orange vinaigrette and toss to combine. Divide the freekeh salad among plates. Top with the avocado, goat cheese and remaining pepitas. Enjoy!

Kitchen hack: To speed up the ripening process, put the avocado in a paper bag and close loosely, then leave on the kitchen bench for a day or two. Add a banana to the bag to make the avocado ripen faster.
